findings.finding: The mapped cell area is usable only under exact same backend semantics, source scope, and SRAM port cut; the bare true boolean is too broad outside its receipt context.
findings.impact: A consumer could launder logic-only standard-cell area into total or macro-inclusive PPA.
findings.required_condition: Carry the full same-flow logic-only diagnostic qualifier and pin the exact receipt/manifest in every M99 comparison.

findings.finding: The 3 ns point has -1.1583 ns setup slack and cuts the address-to-SRAM-to-data path.
findings.impact: M97 is neither a 3 ns timing baseline nor a complete PWP timing/PPA result.
findings.required_condition: Use setup only to identify the M85 audit bottleneck; require M99 to meet the fixed target and later run macro-inclusive timing.

findings.finding: The pre-lock launcher returned 2 after backend completion and did not self-attest all semantic input hashes; the hardened launcher SHA cannot be backfilled.
findings.impact: The run is a reviewed backend data point, not a hardened wrapper-sealed pass.
findings.required_condition: Retain both launcher SHAs and rerun only if wrapper-sealed admission is required.

findings.finding: Hold is MET with zero violations, but worst slack displays as 0.0000 ns at four decimal places.
findings.impact: The result has no demonstrably comfortable hold margin.
findings.required_condition: Require an independently MET M99 hold report and do not advertise hold margin from M97.

findings.finding: Postcompile check_design reports beat_width[3], beat_accept, and collecting unconnected inside M82.
findings.impact: These do not create unresolved logic but should remain identical or explained in the M99 arm.
findings.required_condition: Keep the observability boundary consistent in M99 or record the deliberate difference.

findings.finding: Signed-conversion, high-fanout-1000, DesignWare, and ZeroWireload warnings remain in the diagnostic flow.
findings.impact: They reinforce that mapped cell area is not routed timing, power, or physical area.
findings.required_condition: Keep warning accounting in the same-flow A/B and close physical effects in later macro/STA/PTPX work.
